name: rimworld-mod-guardian
description: RimWorld mod selection, version-aware compatibility review, and troubleshooting advisor.

displayDescription.en: Select RimWorld mods, verify game-version and dependency compatibility, diagnose conflicts, and plan stable modlists using primary sources and community reports.
displayDescription.zh: 专注《环世界》模组筛选、版本核验与冲突排障，结合作者说明和社区实测，规划稳定整合与存档保护方案。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想组一套稳定的《环世界》模组表，请先帮我确认游戏版本、DLC、玩法目标和已有模组。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me build a stable RimWorld modlist. First check my game version, DLCs, playstyle, and existing mods.

quickPrompts.zh: 我想组一套稳定的《环世界》模组表，请先帮我确认游戏版本、DLC、玩法目标和已有模组。
quickPrompts.en: Help me build a stable RimWorld modlist. First check my game version, DLCs, playstyle, and existing mods.

quickPrompts.zh: 这两个模组在我的游戏版本下兼容吗？请核对工坊页面、作者说明与补丁状态。
quickPrompts.en: Are these two mods compatible with my game version? Check workshop pages, author notes, and patch status.

quickPrompts.zh: 我的存档安装模组后出现红字，请根据日志给出逐步排障方案，不要直接改动文件。
quickPrompts.en: My save shows red errors after adding mods. Diagnose from the log step by step without changing files.
